name: Chillwind Horns
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I have most of what Tinkee needs, but I'm missing one important component, and that's chillwind horns.  The horns of the chillwind chimaera in Winterspring are a concentrated source of cold, but only pristine, uncracked horns will do!  I'll need a supply of those to complete Tinkee's order.

Bring me the uncracked chillwind horns, and I'll prepare a package for Tinkee.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.
narrative.offerRewardText: These are good specimens. They're packed with cold! Let me get some gloves on, then pack them along with the other things Tinkee needs...
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the chillwind horns, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 52 to 60, 51,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Broodling Essence
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
quests.objectiveText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.objectiveText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.
